Yu3.tie_definition: Exact equality of saved scores or integer ranking keys; no tolerance or outer-test tie-break.
Yu3.noise_tie: All equal fold leaders receive a win (totals may exceed five); maximum wins only; equal vote leaders retained; five-fold means are descriptive only.
Yu3.missing_tie: Strictly beat same-fold No-Defense; maximize min(random wins,consecutive wins), then total wins; retain all exact ties. No-Defense is anchor.
